concept: A button is an object held in the hand of the pane. It is a pill that lifts when approached and gives a little when pressed, with one loud kind per pane.

root.why: a full pill because it is held, with the label centred and the whole pill as the target

sm.why: small is 32px for dense rows and toolbars where several actions share a line

md.why: medium is the default 44px touch size, used for every action that is not in a dense row

light.why: the loud solid, the one main action of a pane, white in dark and ink in light

accent.why: blue for a promoted action such as Get verified, never next to a loud solid of equal weight

glass.why: the quiet glass fill for every secondary action, visible as an object without shouting

hover.why: hover lifts the button two pixels closer, an object rising to meet the pointer

active.why: a press shrinks the control briefly and faster than hover, because a press is a reply to the reader

disabled.why: disabled uses the native attribute and half opacity, and the reason is written near it

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo so the focused control is visible on any scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop glass and fills, so a real system-colour border is drawn to keep the shape visible

background-color.why: the accent hover darkens at hover pace so colour and lift read as one event

transform.why: lift and press both move by transform over the soft curve so they never shift layout

box-shadow.why: the shadow eases with the lift so the button appears to rise off the pane
